title: Recap: kimondta, hogy ... and Verbs for Laws

sections.title: Legal and Declarative Framing in Historical Hungarian
sections.content: You know *hogy*-clauses from A2 Unit 11, and you met the Diet of Torda and *vallásszabadság* in B1 Unit 20. History texts report what a law said with *kimondta, hogy* ('declared that'). Two more verbs for laws are new words here: *törvénybe iktat* ('enact into law') and *kinyilvánít* ('proclaim').

items.spanish: Az 1568-as tordai országgyűlés törvénybe iktatta a vallásszabadságot.
items.english: The 1568 Diet of Torda enacted religious freedom into law.

items.spanish: A híres törvény kimondta, hogy a hitért senkit sem szabad fogságba vetni.
items.english: The famous law declared that no one may be thrown into prison for their faith.

items.spanish: Később négy vallás lett bevett vallás Erdélyben: a katolikus, az evangélikus, a református és az unitárius.
items.english: Later four religions became received religions in Transylvania: the Catholic, the Lutheran, the Reformed and the Unitarian.
